snippet.title: EXCLUSIVE: Doodle Jump DC Super Heroes Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The worlds of DC Comics and Doodle Jump collide in Doodle Jump: DC Super Heroes, an exciting new mobile game coming this month to an iOS smartphone near you. Check out the announcement trailer and start stretching those fingers now. The Gotham City skyline needs you!

Be sure to watch this week's full episode of DC All Access, co-hosted by special guest Kevin Smith: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EBEs547D8fc

Tiffany’s dress is from the new Hot Topic Harleen line, available Feb. 2015.
#DC #DCComics #DCUniverse
